Beast Whisperer.name: Beast Whisperer
Beast Whisperer.oracle_text: Whenever you cast a creature spell, draw a card.

Eternal Witness.name: Eternal Witness
Eternal Witness.oracle_text: When this creature enters, you may return target card from your graveyard to your hand.

Rest in Peace.name: Rest in Peace
Rest in Peace.oracle_text:
When this enchantment enters, exile all graveyards.
If a card or token would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.

When this creature enters, create a 0/1 green Plant creature token for each land you control.

Blood Artist.name: Blood Artist
Blood Artist.oracle_text: Whenever this creature or another creature dies, target player loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.

Hardened Scales.name: Hardened Scales
Hardened Scales.oracle_text: If one or more +1/+1 counters would be put on a creature you control, that many plus one +1/+1 counters are put on it instead.

Sigarda's Aid.name: Sigarda's Aid
Sigarda's Aid.oracle_text:

Young Pyromancer.name: Young Pyromancer

Austere Command.oracle_text:

• Destroy all creatures with mana value 4 or greater.
